sources.title: LFM2.5-8B-A1B - Liquid Docs
sources.snippet: ← Back to Text Models LFM2.5-8B-A1B is Liquid AI's Mixture-of-Experts model, combining 8B total parameters with only 1.5B active parameters per forward pass with a 128K context window and chain of thought reasoning. This model delivers exceptional performance in tool calling and agentic tasks while running on-device.
